qualifier: Th1 bias via IL-12 and IFN-gamma production
name: IL-12-driven Th1 lineage commitment and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members concern CD4 helper fate decisions (Th1 differentiation, Th17/Treg restraint, memory) driven by IL-12 signalling and IFN-gamma/IL-12 production, whereas confusables centre on the response to IFN-gamma, MHC induction, Treg differentiation or NKT cells.

qualifier: cadherin and TGFBR3 gene targets
name: Transcriptional control of cadherin and TGFBR3 genes via DNA binding
rationale: All members concern transcription-factor DNA binding and repression of initiation, applied to CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3 genes, while confusables add EMT, adhesion, BMP/SMAD or RUNX3/FOXO targets instead of the DNA-binding regulation terms.

qualifier: tachykinin and GnRH receptors in reproduction
name: Tachykinin and PLC-calcium GPCR signalling in reproduction
rationale: Members combine tachykinin and GnRH receptor PLC/IP3/calcium signalling with reproductive outputs (erection, mating, insemination, uterine contraction, parturition), distinguishing them from confusables about gut/urinary smooth muscle contraction or cAMP-coupled GPCR signalling.

qualifier: cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth and regeneration
name: Myocardial growth via cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and regeneration
rationale: Members concern building and maintaining heart muscle (trabecular and compact myocardium, cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation, hypertrophy, regeneration), whereas confusables cover valve, septum and outflow morphogenesis, muscle adaptation or vascular development.

qualifier: ARF and Rab GTPase regulation
name: Golgi organization and endocytic recycling under ARF/Rab control
rationale: Members cover Golgi ribbon assembly/disassembly and positioning, COPI budding, endosome tubulation and receptor recycling together with ARF/Rab GTPase regulators, which the confusables (retrograde Golgi-ER and Golgi-lysosome traffic) lack.

qualifier: coupled to succinate oxidation and ATP synthesis
name: TCA cycle coupled to succinate oxidation and ATP synthesis
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates (2-oxoglutarate, succinate, malate, pyruvate) plus complex II electron transfer and ATP synthase, distinguishing them from confusables about glutamate/aspartate anaplerosis, isocitrate/NADPH or PDH/CoA.

qualifier: T cell and thymocyte centred
name: T cell–centred lymphocyte development and activation signatures
rationale: All members are T/B lymphocyte development and activation modules dominated by T cell differentiation, costimulation and double-positive thymocytes, whereas confusables focus on IL-2/IL-7 TCR signalling, thymic selection or B cell and germinal-centre biology.

qualifier: ear, olfactory and cranial sensory nerves
name: Ear, olfactory and cranial sensory nerve development
rationale: Members are the placode-derived sensory structures of the head (inner, middle and outer ear, nose and olfactory nerve with GnRH neuron migration, taste papillae, cranial ganglia and nerves VII/VIII), unlike confusables on hindbrain motor neurons, hair-cell fate, face/skull morphogenesis or glands.

qualifier: calcium-dependent assembly
name: Calcium-dependent adherens junction assembly
rationale: All three members concern building adherens junctions through calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and protein recruitment, whereas confusables address junction maintenance, polarity or CDH1/CDH11 processing and degradation.

qualifier: GDP-mannose supply and congenital disorders of glycosylation
name: Dolichol-linked N-glycan precursor assembly and its CDG defects
rationale: Members are dolichol, GDP-mannose and lipid-linked oligosaccharide (ALG) synthesis steps and their congenital disorders of glycosylation, while confusables cover N-glycan processing, nucleotide-sugar transport, sialic acid or GPI anchoring.

qualifier: in neurons: mitochondria, dense-core and synaptic vesicles
name: Neuronal microtubule transport of mitochondria and synaptic cargo
rationale: Members are axonal/dendritic microtubule transport of mitochondria, dense-core and synaptic vesicles and receptor cargo, distinguishing them from confusables about tubulin modification, kinesin families, microtubule severing or endolysosome size.

qualifier: CFTR trafficking and anion/water transport
name: Polarized epithelial protein sorting and CFTR anion transport
rationale: Members concern apical/basolateral and raft delivery of membrane proteins from the Golgi plus CFTR trafficking and transepithelial anion/water transport, unlike confusables on tight junctions and microvilli, lipid flippases or bile secretion.

qualifier: CTNNB1 phosphosite and AXIN missense mutants
name: Beta-catenin phosphosite and AXIN missense mutants escaping degradation
rationale: All members are disease mutants (CTNNB1 S33/S37/T41/S45, AXIN missense) that escape destruction-complex phosphorylation, while confusables cover normal Wnt activation, AXIN deletions, APC truncations or TCF/LEF transcription.

qualifier: AU-rich element binding proteins and 3'-UTR silencing
name: AU-rich element mRNA decay and 3'-UTR translational silencing
rationale: Members are ARE-binding proteins (TTP, AUF1, KSRP, BRF1, HuR) regulating mRNA stability plus 3'-UTR-mediated translational silencing, distinguishing them from confusables on RNA editing/PKR, stress granules or AP-1 immediate-early programs.

qualifier: protein refolding and mitochondrial unfolded protein response
name: HSF1 heat shock response with refolding and mitochondrial UPR
rationale: Members are HSF1 activation/attenuation and heat acclimation plus chaperone refolding and UPRmt, which distinguish the theme from confusables pairing heat shock with protein acetylation or stress granules, and from ER folding or FOXO stress programs.

qualifier: proline, glycine and glyoxylate
name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are generic amino/organic acid metabolism terms anchored by proline synthesis/catabolism and glycine/glyoxylate metabolism, without the aromatic, histidine or threonine catabolism or glycine conjugation seen in confusables.

qualifier: GPVI collagen-receptor cascade
name: Platelet aggregation control via GPVI activation cascade
rationale: Members are platelet activation modules, positive and negative regulation of aggregation and the GPVI cascade, unlike confusables centred on GPCR agonists (ADP, thrombin, thromboxane) or VWF-GPIb adhesion.
Members mix regulation of drug and antibiotic responses, oxidative stress, hypoxia and developmental apoptosis with no single specific biological process common to all five.

qualifier: target gene transcription output
name: Notch target gene transcriptional output
rationale: All three members describe transcription of Notch target genes (HLH program), whereas confusables cover Notch receptor processing, paralog-specific NICD signalling or NOTCH1 cancer mutants.

qualifier: with HSF1 heat shock regulation
name: Protein lysine acetylation and HSF1 heat shock response
rationale: Members combine histone, tubulin and N-terminal protein acetylation with HSF1-mediated heat shock regulation, distinguishing them from confusables on protein methylation, chromatin assembly/BAF remodelling, or heat shock with refolding.

qualifier: ERAD regulation and reticulophagy
name: Misfolded protein quality control via ERAD and reticulophagy
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein responses, ubiquitination and Josephin DUBs with regulation of ERAD and reticulophagy, whereas confusables emphasize ubiquitin chain types, aggrephagy/chaperone-mediated autophagy or ribosome quality control.

qualifier: sex determination, gonad, prostate and Mullerian tract
name: Sex determination, gonad, prostate and genital tract development
rationale: Members span sex determination, gonad and Leydig cell development, AMH signalling, prostate morphogenesis and Mullerian/genital tract organs, unlike confusables on germ cells and Sertoli cells, mammary gland or pancreas.

qualifier: chemokine ligand-receptor gene clusters and monocyte differentiation
name: Chemokine ligand-receptor clusters in leukocyte chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine and chemokine receptor modules driving leukocyte (NK, monocyte) chemotaxis, while confusables specialise to CCR7/dendritic cell migration, lymphocyte homing or CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte modules.

qualifier: keratinocyte proliferation and IL-20 family signalling
name: Keratinocyte wound re-epithelialization with IL-20 family signalling
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial migration and proliferation, epidermal spreading and wound inflammation with IL-20 family cytokines, whereas confusables concern inhibition of cell migration/adhesion or keratinocyte differentiation.

qualifier: collagen adhesion via GPVI and GPIb, aggregation and degranulation
name: Platelet adhesion, activation and aggregation via GPVI and GPIb
rationale: Members span platelet adhesion to collagen (GPVI, GPIb-IX-V), activation, aggregation, degranulation and coagulation modules, distinguishing them from the plasma coagulation cascade, VWF variant, and ADP P2Y receptor confusables.
